source.text: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ παντὶ πνεύματι πιστεύετε, ἀλλὰ δοκιμάζετε τὰ πνεύματα εἰ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, ὅτι πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐξεληλύθασιν εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

records.literal_gloss: Beloved, not every spirit believe, but test the spirits whether from God they are, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

en.L: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits [to see] whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
en.B: Dear friends, do not believe just any spirit; test the spirits to find out whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out and are now in the world.
en.R: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit that speaks through a prophet. Test them to find out whether they really come from God. You need to do this, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

fr.L: Bien-aimés, ne croyez pas à tout esprit, mais éprouvez les esprits [pour voir] s’ils sont de Dieu, car beaucoup de faux prophètes sont sortis dans le monde.
fr.B: Chers amis, ne croyez pas n’importe quel esprit ; mettez les esprits à l’épreuve pour savoir s’ils viennent de Dieu, car beaucoup de faux prophètes sont sortis et se trouvent maintenant dans le monde.
fr.R: Chers amis, ne croyez pas tout esprit qui parle par la bouche d’un prophète. Mettez-les à l’épreuve pour savoir s’ils viennent vraiment de Dieu. Vous devez le faire, car beaucoup de faux prophètes se sont répandus dans le monde.

es.L: Amados, no {{plural_you:crean|creáis}} a todo espíritu, sino {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} a prueba los espíritus [para ver] si son de Dios, porque muchos falsos profetas han salido al mundo.
es.B: Queridos amigos, no {{plural_you:crean|creáis}} a cualquier espíritu; {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} a prueba los espíritus para saber si son de Dios, porque muchos falsos profetas han salido y ahora están en el mundo.
es.R: Queridos amigos, no {{plural_you:crean|creáis}} a todo espíritu que habla por medio de un profeta. {{plural_you:Pónganlos|Ponedlos}} a prueba para saber si de verdad vienen de Dios. {{plural_you:Necesitan|Necesitáis}} hacerlo, porque muchos falsos profetas han salido al mundo.

sw.L: Wapendwa, msiamini kila roho, bali zipimeni roho hizo [mwone] kama zinatoka kwa Mungu, kwa sababu manabii wengi wa uongo wametoka kwenda ulimwenguni.
sw.B: Rafiki zangu wapendwa, msiamini roho yoyote tu; zipimeni roho ili mjue kama zinatoka kwa Mungu, kwa maana manabii wengi wa uongo wametoka, na sasa wako ulimwenguni.
sw.R: Rafiki zangu wapendwa, msiamini kila roho inayosema kupitia nabii. Zipimeni ili mjue kama kweli zinatoka kwa Mungu. Mnahitaji kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu manabii wengi wa uongo wametoka kwenda ulimwenguni.

ko.L: 사랑하는 여러분, 모든 영을 믿지 말고, 그 영들이 하나님에게서 났는지 시험해 보십시오. 많은 거짓 예언자들이 세상에 나왔기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 사랑하는 여러분, 아무 영이나 다 믿지 마십시오. 그 영들이 하나님에게서 온 것인지 시험해 보십시오. 많은 거짓 예언자들이 세상에 나와 있기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 예언자를 통해 말하는 영을 다 믿지 마십시오. 그 영이 정말 하나님에게서 왔는지 시험해 보십시오. 여러분은 그렇게 해야 합니다. 많은 거짓 예언자들이 세상에 나와 있기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: dear ones: a warm address to the readers, built on the word for love
alternatives: those loved by God (as a title)
decisions.reason: Ἀγαπητοί comes from the verb ἀγαπάω (love) and is the letter's usual affectionate address (2:7; 3:2, 21; 4:7, 11). In 4:7 and 4:11 it opens a call to love, so the link with love is felt there.

decisions.choice: spirit: the spiritual power that speaks through a prophet
decisions.reason: The spirits are tested by what is said (4:2-3), and each one is either the Spirit of God or the spirit of the antichrist (4:3, 6). Every prophet claims to speak by a spirit; testing the spirits means testing what the prophets say. Compare 1 Corinthians 12:10 and 14:32.

decisions.choice: a standing rule: do not go on believing every spirit
decisions.reason: A negative with the present imperative forbids a habit or continuing practice. The readers are not to accept a message simply because it claims the Spirit; the companion command to test is also present: keep testing.

decisions.choice: false prophets: people who claim to speak for God when he has not sent them
decisions.reason: The law of Moses gave tests for prophets (Deuteronomy 13:1-5; 18:20-22), and Jesus warned that false prophets would come (Matthew 24:11, 24). "Have gone out" uses the same verb as 2:19, where those who left the community "went out from us"; the letter seems to connect the two.

decisions.choice: the world: human society that does not know God, where these prophets now find a hearing
decisions.reason: Key term. The sense is set by 4:5: they belong to the world and the world listens to them (compare 2:15-17; 5:19).

decisions.choice: Beloved (L); Dear friends (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Beloved" is now heard mostly in church or as old-fashioned; "Dear friends" is the natural warm address. Literal keeps "Beloved" so the reader can see that the word is built on "love" (meaning decision m1). The same choice is made in 4:7 and 4:11.

decisions.choice: every spirit that speaks through a prophet
decisions.reason: Readable says what the spirits are in this passage (meaning decision m2), since "spirit" alone gives a young reader no picture.

decisions.choice: have gone out and are now in the world
alternatives: have gone out into the world
decisions.reason: The perfect tense says they went out and are now at work; Balanced spells out the second half. Literal and Readable keep the plain wording.

decisions.choice: Amados (L); Queridos amigos (B, R); ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: As in 2:7 and 3:2. Every plural "you" and its verb is the ustedes / vosotros reader setting, as in the rest of the letter.

decisions.choice: roho (lowercase, class 9/10 agreement: zinatoka)
decisions.reason: A spirit here is the spiritual power that speaks through a prophet (m2). Swahili "roho" covers it; "pepo" means demons and would decide in advance that every such spirit is evil. Lowercase "roho" with thing agreement ("zinatoka") keeps these spirits apart from the Spirit of God in verse 2, written "Roho" with personal agreement.

decisions.choice: zipimeni
decisions.reason: The verb is to test something to see whether it is genuine. "Kupima" (weigh, examine) says that; "kujaribu" also means to tempt.

decisions.choice: "영" for the spirits that speak through prophets; "시험해 보다" for test; "거짓 예언자"
decisions.reason: The spirit is the spiritual power that speaks through a prophet (meaning decision), so Korean says "영" and keeps "성령" for the Holy Spirit (4:2). "시험하다" is the plain word for testing whether something is genuine; "예언자" as the style guide sets.

source.text: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκετε τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ· πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ ὁμολογεῖ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκὶ ἐληλυθότα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ μὴ ὁμολογεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν· καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου, ὃ ἀκηκόατε ὅτι ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν ἤδη.

records.literal_gloss: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ in flesh having come from God is, \v 3 and every spirit that not confesses the Jesus from God not is; and this is the [spirit] of the antichrist, which you have heard that it is coming, and now in the world it is already.

en.L: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} having come in [the] flesh is from God, \v 3 and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God; and this is the [spirit] of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming, and now it is in the world already.
en.B: Here is how you recognize the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} as one who has come in the flesh is from God, \v 3 and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist; you have heard that it is coming, and now it is already in the world.
en.R: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God. Every spirit that openly says that Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} came as a real human being is from God. \v 3 But every spirit that will not say this about Jesus is not from God. That is the spirit of the antichrist. You have heard that it was coming, and now it is already in the world.

fr.L: À ceci vous connaissez l’Esprit de Dieu : tout esprit qui confesse Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} venu dans la chair est de Dieu, \v 3 et tout esprit qui ne confesse pas Jésus n’est pas de Dieu ; et c’est celui de l’antichrist, dont vous avez entendu qu’il vient, et maintenant il est déjà dans le monde.
fr.B: Voici comment vous reconnaissez l’Esprit de Dieu : tout esprit qui confesse Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} comme venu dans la chair est de Dieu, \v 3 et tout esprit qui ne confesse pas Jésus n’est pas de Dieu. C’est l’esprit de l’antichrist ; vous avez entendu dire qu’il vient, et maintenant il est déjà dans le monde.
fr.R: Voici comment vous pouvez reconnaître l’Esprit de Dieu. Tout esprit qui dit ouvertement que Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est venu comme un vrai être humain vient de Dieu. \v 3 Mais tout esprit qui refuse de dire cela de Jésus ne vient pas de Dieu. C’est l’esprit de l’antichrist. Vous avez entendu dire qu’il allait venir, et maintenant il est déjà dans le monde.

es.L: En esto {{plural_you:conocen|conocéis}} el Espíritu de Dios: todo espíritu que confiesa a {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} venido en [la] carne es de Dios, \v 3 y todo espíritu que no confiesa a Jesús no es de Dios; y este es el [espíritu] del anticristo, del cual {{plural_you:han|habéis}} oído que viene, y ahora ya está en el mundo.
es.B: Así es como {{plural_you:reconocen|reconocéis}} el Espíritu de Dios: todo espíritu que confiesa a {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} como aquel que ha venido en la carne es de Dios, \v 3 y todo espíritu que no confiesa a Jesús no es de Dios. Este es el espíritu del anticristo; {{plural_you:ustedes han|vosotros habéis}} oído que viene, y ahora ya está en el mundo.
es.R: Así es como {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} reconocer el Espíritu de Dios. Todo espíritu que dice abiertamente que {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} vino como un ser humano de verdad es de Dios. \v 3 Pero todo espíritu que no quiere decir esto de Jesús no es de Dios. Ese es el espíritu del anticristo. {{plural_you:Ustedes oyeron|Vosotros oísteis}} que vendría, y ahora ya está en el mundo.

sw.L: Kwa hili mnamtambua Roho wa Mungu: kila roho inayomkiri Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kuwa amekuja katika mwili inatoka kwa Mungu, \v 3 na kila roho isiyomkiri Yesu haitoki kwa Mungu; na hii ndiyo [roho] ya mpinga-Kristo, ambayo mmesikia kwamba inakuja, na sasa iko ulimwenguni tayari.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo mnavyomtambua Roho wa Mungu: kila roho inayomkiri Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kuwa amekuja katika mwili inatoka kwa Mungu, \v 3 na kila roho isiyomkiri Yesu haitoki kwa Mungu. Hiyo ndiyo roho ya mpinga-Kristo; mmesikia kwamba inakuja, na sasa tayari iko ulimwenguni.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo mnavyoweza kumtambua Roho wa Mungu. Kila roho inayosema waziwazi kwamba Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikuja kama binadamu halisi inatoka kwa Mungu. \v 3 Lakini kila roho isiyokubali kusema hivyo kuhusu Yesu haitoki kwa Mungu. Hiyo ndiyo roho ya mpinga-Kristo. Mlisikia kwamba inakuja, na sasa tayari iko ulimwenguni.

ko.L: 이것으로 여러분은 하나님의 영을 압니다. 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 육신으로 오셨다고 시인하는 영은 모두 하나님에게서 난 것이고, \v 3 예수를 시인하지 않는 영은 모두 하나님에게서 난 것이 아닙니다. 이것이 적그리스도의 [영]입니다. 그것이 온다는 말을 여러분이 들었는데, 지금 이미 세상에 와 있습니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 이렇게 하나님의 영을 알아볼 수 있습니다. 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 육신을 입고 오신 분이심을 시인하는 영은 모두 하나님에게서 온 영이고, \v 3 예수를 시인하지 않는 영은 모두 하나님에게서 온 영이 아닙니다. 그것은 적그리스도의 영입니다. 여러분은 그 영이 온다는 말을 들었는데, 그 영이 지금 이미 세상에 와 있습니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 이렇게 하나님의 영을 알아볼 수 있습니다. 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 참사람으로 오셨다고 분명히 말하는 영은 모두 하나님에게서 온 영입니다. \v 3 그러나 예수님에 대해 그렇게 말하지 않는 영은 하나님에게서 온 영이 아닙니다. 그것은 적그리스도의 영입니다. 여러분은 그 영이 오고 있다는 말을 들었는데, 지금 이미 세상에 와 있습니다.

decisions.choice: a statement: this is how you know
alternatives: a command: know (recognize) the Spirit of God by this
decisions.reason: The form γινώσκετε can be a statement or a command. The parallel at the end of the section, "from this we know" (4:6), favors a statement. Either way the sentence gives the test.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of God: the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: Against the many spirits of 4:1, there is one Spirit of God, who is also called the Spirit of truth (4:6) and whom God has given to believers (3:24; 4:13).

decisions.choice: confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh: the participle states what is confessed about him
alternatives: confesses Jesus as the Christ who has come in the flesh
confesses Jesus Christ, who has come in the flesh (the participle only describing him)
decisions.reason: After a verb of saying or confessing, an object followed by a participle gives the content of what is said. The stress falls on "in flesh": the test is not whether a spirit names Jesus Christ but whether it confesses that he came as a real human being. The perfect ἐληλυθότα says he came and remains the one who came in the flesh. 2 John 7 states the same confession with a present participle.

decisions.choice: in flesh: a real human body and human life
alternatives: the heavenly Christ resting on the man Jesus for a time
decisions.reason: The confession matches John 1:14 ("the Word became flesh") and the eyewitness claim of 1:1-3 (what we heard, saw and touched). The letter does not name the false teachers. It is well known that some in the early second century taught that Christ only seemed to have a body; whether this letter faces exactly that teaching, or one that separated the divine Christ from the human Jesus (compare 2:22), is not certain. The confession answers both.

decisions.choice: does not confess Jesus (all known Greek manuscripts; SBLGNT)
alternatives: "annuls Jesus" or "separates Jesus" (λύει instead of μὴ ὁμολογεῖ)
does not confess Jesus Christ as having come in the flesh (later manuscripts filling out the phrase from 4:2)
decisions.reason: Every known Greek manuscript of the letter has "does not confess". But a reading "which annuls (or dissolves) Jesus" was known early: it is in the Latin Vulgate (solvit), it is quoted by some early church writers, and a note in the margin of minuscule 1739 says Origen knew it. It reads like a sharpened interpretation aimed at teachers who split Jesus from the Christ. Many later manuscripts also fill out the confession from 4:2 ("Jesus Christ has come in the flesh"). The SBLGNT follows the oldest Greek text. A reviewer must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: this Jesus: the one just confessed as come in the flesh
alternatives: refusing to speak of Jesus at all
decisions.reason: The article points back to the Jesus of the previous clause. Not confessing him means refusing the confession just given, not simply never mentioning his name.

decisions.choice: the spirit of the antichrist: the neuter article stands for "spirit"
alternatives: the work or doing of the antichrist
decisions.reason: τὸ is neuter, like πνεῦμα; the whole passage is about spirits, so the word to be supplied is "spirit".

decisions.choice: the antichrist: the opponent of Christ expected at the end, whose spirit is already at work
decisions.reason: The readers had been taught that the antichrist was coming (2:18). John says many antichrists have already come (2:18, 22; 2 John 7): the spirit of the expected opponent is already speaking through false prophets. The prefix means against, and can also mean in place of.

decisions.choice: confesses (L, B); openly says (R)
decisions.reason: To confess here is to declare publicly what one holds true and stands by, not to admit wrongdoing. Literal and Balanced keep the church word "confess"; Readable says plainly what it means. The same choice is made in 4:15.

decisions.choice: as one who has come in the flesh (B); came as a real human being (R)
alternatives: that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the object-and-participle shape of meaning decision m3 so the confession stays about the person. Readable explains "in the flesh" (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: the [spirit] of the antichrist (L); the spirit of the antichrist (B, R)
decisions.reason: English needs the noun the Greek leaves understood (meaning decision m7).

decisions.choice: antichrist, with no christos setting
decisions.reason: The christos setting gives a choice for the title Christ. "Antichrist" is one established word, and "anti-Messiah" is not standard usage; meaning decision m8 says what the word means.

decisions.choice: will not say this about Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable makes explicit that the refusal is of the confession just given (meaning decision m6).

decisions.choice: c’est celui de l’antichrist (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek article stands for "spirit" (m7). French says this with the pronoun "celui", which needs no bracket; Balanced and Readable name "l’esprit", as the English does. "La chair" at Literal and Balanced, as the term sheet sets; Readable explains it as in 2 John 7.

decisions.choice: en [la] carne (L); en la carne (B); como un ser humano de verdad (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2 John 7: "carne" here means a real human body and life (meaning decision m2), not the sinful nature; Readable says that plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: kumkiri (L, B); kusema waziwazi (R); katika mwili (L, B); kama binadamu halisi (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:23 and 2 John 7: "kukiri" is to declare openly who Jesus is (m3), and Readable says "say openly", as the English Readable does. "Katika mwili" keeps the Greek "in flesh", a real human body and life (m4); Readable says "as a real human being", as 2 John 7 does.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 영" (L, B, R) for the Spirit of God; "육신으로 오셨다" (L); "육신을 입고 오신" (B); "참사람으로 오셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Spirit of God is the Holy Spirit (meaning decision), named here by the phrase the Greek uses, with the honorific not needed in the test itself. In the flesh means a real human body and human life (meaning decision, footnoted): "육신" is the word of the Korean John 1:14, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστε, τεκνία, καὶ νενικήκατε αὐτούς, ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν ἢ ὁ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ·

records.literal_gloss: You from God are, little children, and you have overcome them, because greater is the [one] in you than the [one] in the world;

en.L: You are from God, little children, and you have overcome them, because greater is the one in you than the one in the world.
en.B: As for you, dear children, you belong to God, and you have already won the victory over them, because the one in you is greater than the one in the world.
en.R: But you, dear children, belong to God. You have already won the fight against these false prophets, because God, who lives in you, is greater than the devil, who is in the world.

fr.L: Vous, vous êtes de Dieu, petits enfants, et vous les avez vaincus, parce que celui qui est en vous est plus grand que celui qui est dans le monde.
fr.B: Quant à vous, mes chers enfants, vous appartenez à Dieu, et vous avez déjà remporté la victoire sur eux, car celui qui est en vous est plus grand que celui qui est dans le monde.
fr.R: Mais vous, mes chers enfants, vous appartenez à Dieu. Vous avez déjà gagné le combat contre ces faux prophètes, parce que Dieu, qui vit en vous, est plus grand que le diable, qui est dans le monde.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} de Dios, hijitos, y los {{plural_you:han|habéis}} vencido, porque mayor es el que está en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que el que está en el mundo.
es.B: En cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hijitos, {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} a Dios, y ya los {{plural_you:han|habéis}} vencido, porque el que está en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es mayor que el que está en el mundo.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hijos queridos, {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} a Dios. Ya {{plural_you:han|habéis}} ganado la lucha contra esos falsos profetas, porque Dios, que vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, es más grande que el diablo, que está en el mundo.

sw.L: Ninyi mmetoka kwa Mungu, watoto wadogo, nanyi mmewashinda, kwa sababu mkuu zaidi ni yule aliye ndani yenu kuliko yule aliye ulimwenguni.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi, wanangu wapendwa, ni wa Mungu, nanyi tayari mmewashinda, kwa sababu yule aliye ndani yenu ni mkubwa zaidi ya yule aliye ulimwenguni.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi, wanangu wapendwa, ni wa Mungu. Tayari mmeshinda vita dhidi ya manabii hao wa uongo, kwa sababu Mungu, anayeishi ndani yenu, ni mkuu kuliko Ibilisi, aliye ulimwenguni.

ko.L: 어린 자녀 여러분, 여러분은 하나님에게서 났고, 그들을 이겼습니다. 여러분 안에 계신 분이 세상에 있는 자보다 더 크시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 어린 자녀 여러분, 여러분은 하나님께 속해 있고, 이미 그들을 이겼습니다. 여러분 안에 계신 분이 세상에 있는 자보다 더 크시기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 사랑하는 자녀 여러분, 여러분은 하나님께 속해 있습니다. 여러분은 이미 이 거짓 예언자들과 싸워서 이겼습니다. 여러분 안에 사시는 하나님께서 세상에 있는 마귀보다 더 크시기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: you, in contrast with the false prophets
decisions.reason: The pronoun is emphatic and sets the readers against the false prophets of 4:1-3 and "they" in 4:5.

decisions.choice: from God: their life comes from God and they belong to him
decisions.reason: Said of people, being "from" God or "from" the world names where their life comes from and whom they belong to (3:10; 4:5-6; 5:19).

decisions.choice: little children: an affectionate address to all the readers
decisions.reason: John calls all his readers this (2:1, 12, 28; 3:7, 18; 5:21).

decisions.choice: you have overcome them: a victory already won and still standing; "them" are the false prophets
decisions.reason: The perfect speaks of a victory won and lasting. "Them" is masculine and points back to the false prophets of 4:1; the readers have overcome them by not being led astray (2:13-14, 26-27; 5:4-5).

decisions.choice: the one in you: God, living in believers by his Spirit
decisions.reason: The nearby verses speak of God remaining in us and giving us his Spirit (3:24; 4:12-13, 15-16). The letter speaks of God, Christ and the Spirit in believers so closely that the alternatives say much the same.

decisions.choice: the one in the world: the devil, working through the spirit of the antichrist
decisions.reason: Elsewhere the letter calls him the devil and the evil one, and says the whole world lies in his power (3:8, 10; 5:19).

decisions.choice: belong to God (B, R); are from God (L)
alternatives: are from God at every level
decisions.reason: Said of people, "from God" can sound like "sent from God". "Belong to" gives meaning decision m2. The same choice is made for people in 4:5-6.

decisions.choice: dear children; have already won the victory over them (B); have already won the fight against (R)
decisions.reason: "Little children" can sound as if young children were meant (meaning decision m3). "Already" gives the force of the perfect (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: these false prophets; God, who lives in you; the devil
alternatives: them; the one in you; the one in the world
decisions.reason: Readable names who is meant (meaning decisions m4-m6).

decisions.choice: mmetoka kwa Mungu (L); ni wa Mungu (B, R)
decisions.reason: Their life comes from God and they belong to him (m2). Literal keeps "from" with "kutoka kwa"; Balanced and Readable say "ni wa Mungu" (are God's), as the English says "belong to God", and the same pattern is used in verses 5-6.

decisions.choice: "여러분 안에 계신 분" with the honorific; "세상에 있는 자" without it
decisions.reason: The one in you is God, and the one in the world is the devil (meaning decisions). Korean marks the difference with the honorific "계신 분" and the plain "있는 자", as the Greek marks it by the contrast; Readable names both, as the English Readable does.

source.text: αὐτοὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου εἰσίν· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου λαλοῦσιν καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτῶν ἀκούει.

records.literal_gloss: They from the world are; because of this from the world they speak and the world them hears.

en.L: They are from the world; because of this they speak from the world, and the world listens to them.
en.B: They belong to the world, so what they say comes from the world, and the world listens to them.
en.R: Those false prophets belong to the world. That is why they talk the way the world talks, and the world listens to them.

fr.L: Eux, ils sont du monde ; c’est pourquoi ils parlent à partir du monde, et le monde les écoute.
fr.B: Eux appartiennent au monde ; aussi ce qu’ils disent vient du monde, et le monde les écoute.
fr.R: Ces faux prophètes appartiennent au monde. C’est pour cela qu’ils parlent comme parle le monde, et le monde les écoute.

es.L: Ellos son del mundo; por eso hablan desde el mundo, y el mundo los escucha.
es.B: Ellos pertenecen al mundo; por eso lo que dicen viene del mundo, y el mundo los escucha.
es.R: Esos falsos profetas pertenecen al mundo. Por eso hablan como habla el mundo, y el mundo los escucha.

sw.L: Wao wanatoka katika ulimwengu; kwa sababu hiyo wanasema kutoka katika ulimwengu, na ulimwengu unawasikia.
sw.B: Wao ni wa ulimwengu, kwa hiyo wanayoyasema yanatoka kwa ulimwengu, na ulimwengu unawasikiliza.
sw.R: Manabii hao wa uongo ni wa ulimwengu. Ndiyo sababu wanazungumza kama ulimwengu unavyozungumza, na ulimwengu unawasikiliza.

ko.L: 그들은 세상에서 났습니다. 그래서 그들은 세상에서 [난 것을] 말하고, 세상은 그들의 말을 듣습니다.
ko.B: 그들은 세상에 속해 있습니다. 그래서 그들이 하는 말은 세상에서 나오고, 세상은 그들의 말을 듣습니다.
ko.R: 그 거짓 예언자들은 세상에 속해 있습니다. 그래서 그들은 세상 사람들이 말하는 방식으로 말하고, 세상은 그들의 말을 듣습니다.

decisions.choice: they: the false prophets
decisions.reason: The emphatic pronoun answers "you" in 4:4 and points back to the false prophets of 4:1.

decisions.choice: the world: human society organized without God
decisions.reason: Key term. As in 2:15-17 and 5:19: the world here is humanity that does not know God, and it welcomes those who speak its language.

decisions.choice: they speak from the world: what they say has its source in the world's way of thinking
decisions.reason: The phrase names where the speech comes from, not its topic. Compare John 3:31: the one from the earth speaks from the earth.

decisions.choice: listens to: hears with acceptance
decisions.reason: With the person in the genitive the verb means to listen to and accept, as again in 4:6.

decisions.choice: what they say comes from the world (B); they talk the way the world talks (R)
decisions.reason: "Speak from the world" is unclear in English; Balanced and Readable give the sense of meaning decision m3.

decisions.choice: belong to the world
decisions.reason: As "belong to God" in 4:4.

decisions.choice: ils parlent à partir du monde (L)
decisions.reason: "Ils parlent du monde" would be read as "they talk about the world". "À partir du monde" keeps the Greek picture of the source of their speech (m3); Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: unawasikia (L); unawasikiliza (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to hear with acceptance (m4). Literal keeps "kusikia" (hear); Balanced and Readable say "kusikiliza" (listen to), which carries the acceptance, as the English says "listens to". The same in verse 6.

source.text: ἡμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐσμεν· ὁ γινώσκων τὸν θεὸν ἀκούει ἡμῶν, ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἀκούει ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: We from God are; the [one] knowing God hears us, [he] who not is from God not hears us.

en.L: We are from God; the one who knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us.
en.B: We belong to God. Whoever knows God listens to us, and whoever does not belong to God does not listen to us.
en.R: We belong to God. People who know God listen to us. People who do not belong to God will not listen to us.

fr.L: Nous, nous sommes de Dieu ; celui qui connaît Dieu nous écoute ; celui qui n’est pas de Dieu ne nous écoute pas.
fr.B: Nous, nous appartenons à Dieu. Celui qui connaît Dieu nous écoute, et celui qui n’appartient pas à Dieu ne nous écoute pas.
fr.R: Nous appartenons à Dieu. Ceux qui connaissent Dieu nous écoutent. Ceux qui n’appartiennent pas à Dieu ne veulent pas nous écouter.

es.L: Nosotros somos de Dios; el que conoce a Dios nos escucha; el que no es de Dios no nos escucha.
es.B: Nosotros pertenecemos a Dios. Quien conoce a Dios nos escucha, y quien no pertenece a Dios no nos escucha.
es.R: Nosotros pertenecemos a Dios. Las personas que conocen a Dios nos escuchan. Las que no pertenecen a Dios no nos van a escuchar.

sw.L: Sisi tunatoka kwa Mungu; yule anayemjua Mungu anatusikia; ambaye hatoki kwa Mungu hatusikii.
sw.B: Sisi ni wa Mungu. Yeyote anayemjua Mungu anatusikiliza, na yeyote asiye wa Mungu hatusikilizi.
sw.R: Sisi ni wa Mungu. Watu wanaomjua Mungu wanatusikiliza. Watu wasio wa Mungu hawatatusikiliza.

ko.L: 우리는 하나님에게서 났습니다. 하나님을 아는 사람은 우리의 말을 듣고, 하나님에게서 나지 않은 사람은 우리의 말을 듣지 않습니다.
ko.B: 우리는 하나님께 속해 있습니다. 하나님을 아는 사람은 우리의 말을 듣고, 하나님께 속하지 않은 사람은 우리의 말을 듣지 않습니다.
ko.R: 우리는 하나님께 속해 있습니다. 하나님을 아는 사람들은 우리의 말을 듣습니다. 하나님께 속하지 않은 사람들은 우리의 말을 듣지 않을 것입니다.

decisions.choice: we: the witnesses who carry the message heard from the beginning
decisions.reason: "We" is set against "they" (4:5), and listening to "us" is the test. That fits the eyewitnesses who saw and heard and passed the message on (1:1-5; 4:14), and with them all who hold to what was heard from the beginning (2:24). The readers are called "you" in 4:4; in the next sentence "we know" seems to include them.

decisions.choice: knows God: knows him personally, as one who belongs to him
decisions.reason: In this letter knowing God is a relationship shown in obedience and love (2:3-4; 4:7-8).

decisions.choice: listens to: hears with acceptance
decisions.reason: As in 4:5.

decisions.choice: belong to God
decisions.reason: As in 4:4.

decisions.choice: "하나님에게서 났다" (L); "하나님께 속해 있다" (B, R), here and in 4:4-5
decisions.reason: "From God" means their life comes from God and they belong to him (meaning decision). Literal keeps the origin with "났다", as in 2:29 and 3:9; Balanced and Readable say "belong", as the English does.

source.text: ἐκ τούτου γινώσκομεν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πλάνης.

records.literal_gloss: From this we know the Spirit of the truth and the spirit of the error.

en.L: From this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
en.B: That is how we tell the Spirit of truth from the spirit of falsehood.
en.R: This is how we can tell the Spirit of truth from the spirit that leads people astray.

fr.L: Par là nous connaissons l’Esprit de la vérité et l’esprit de l’erreur.
fr.B: C’est ainsi que nous distinguons l’Esprit de vérité de l’esprit de mensonge.
fr.R: Voilà comment nous pouvons distinguer l’Esprit de vérité et l’esprit qui égare les gens.

es.L: Por esto conocemos el Espíritu de la verdad y el espíritu del error.
es.B: Así es como distinguimos el Espíritu de la verdad del espíritu de la falsedad.
es.R: Así es como podemos distinguir el Espíritu de la verdad del espíritu que lleva a la gente por mal camino.

sw.L: Kutokana na hili tunamtambua Roho wa kweli na roho ya upotoshaji.
sw.B: Hivyo ndivyo tunavyomtofautisha Roho wa kweli na roho ya uongo.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo tunavyoweza kumtofautisha Roho wa kweli na roho inayowapotosha watu.

ko.L: 이것으로 우리는 진리의 영과 미혹의 영을 압니다.
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 우리는 진리의 영과 거짓의 영을 구별합니다.
ko.R: 이렇게 하여 우리는 진리의 영과 사람들을 잘못된 길로 이끄는 영을 구별할 수 있습니다.

decisions.choice: from this: from who listens to the message and who does not
decisions.reason: Nothing follows in the sentence, so τούτου points back to 4:6a, and through it to the confession of 4:2-3.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of truth: the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: Jesus calls the Holy Spirit "the Spirit of truth" (John 14:17; 15:26; 16:13), and this letter says the Spirit is the truth (5:6). It is the same Spirit of God as in 4:2.

decisions.choice: the spirit of error: the spirit that leads people astray
decisions.reason: πλάνη means wandering from the way, and so deception. Its verb is used of those who lead the readers astray (2:26; 3:7). It is the spirit of the antichrist of 4:3.

decisions.choice: two spirits set against each other
decisions.reason: Jewish writings of the time also spoke this way: the Community Rule among the Dead Sea Scrolls speaks of a spirit of truth and a spirit of deceit at work in people. The letter shares the language but grounds it in the confession of Jesus.

decisions.choice: error (L); falsehood (B); that leads people astray (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the familiar "error"; Balanced pairs "falsehood" with "truth"; Readable says what the spirit does (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: tell ... from
decisions.reason: The point is to tell the two spirits apart; "tell one from the other" says so.

decisions.choice: el Espíritu de la verdad
decisions.reason: As in John 14:17 and 16:13, Spanish says "el Espíritu de la verdad", with the article the Greek has.

decisions.choice: roho ya upotoshaji (L); roho ya uongo (B); roho inayowapotosha watu (R)
decisions.reason: The spirit that leads people astray (m3). Literal uses "upotoshaji", from the verb "kupotosha" used for the deceivers in 2:26; Balanced says "uongo" (falsehood) and Readable spells it out, as the English does. "Roho wa kweli" is the Holy Spirit (m2), as in John 14:17, with personal agreement and a capital.

decisions.choice: "진리의 영" for the Spirit of truth, as in the Korean John 16:13; "미혹의 영" (L); "거짓의 영" (B); "잘못된 길로 이끄는 영" (R)
decisions.reason: The Spirit of truth is the Holy Spirit (meaning decision), named by the title of the Korean John. The spirit of error is the spirit that leads people astray (meaning decision); Literal keeps "미혹" (leading astray), and Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

source.text: Ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται καὶ γινώσκει τὸν θεόν.

records.literal_gloss: Beloved, let us love one another, because the love from God is, and everyone loving from God has been born and knows God.

en.L: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
en.B: Dear friends, let us keep loving one another, for love has its source in God; everyone who loves is born of God and knows {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Dear friends, let us love each other, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves is God's child and knows God.

fr.L: Bien-aimés, aimons-nous les uns les autres, parce que l’amour est de Dieu, et quiconque aime est né de Dieu et connaît Dieu.
fr.B: Chers amis, continuons à nous aimer les uns les autres, car l’amour a sa source en Dieu ; quiconque aime est né de Dieu et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaît.
fr.R: Chers amis, aimons-nous les uns les autres, parce que l’amour vient de Dieu. Celui qui aime est un enfant de Dieu, et il connaît Dieu.

es.L: Amados, amémonos unos a otros, porque el amor es de Dios, y todo el que ama ha nacido de Dios y conoce a Dios.
es.B: Queridos amigos, sigamos amándonos unos a otros, porque el amor tiene su origen en Dios; todo el que ama ha nacido de Dios y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conoce.
es.R: Queridos amigos, amémonos unos a otros, porque el amor viene de Dios. Todo el que ama es hijo de Dios y conoce a Dios.

sw.L: Wapendwa, tupendane sisi kwa sisi, kwa kuwa upendo ni wa Mungu, na kila mwenye kupenda amezaliwa kutoka kwa Mungu na anamjua Mungu.
sw.B: Rafiki zangu wapendwa, tuendelee kupendana, kwa maana chanzo cha upendo ni Mungu; kila anayependa amezaliwa na Mungu na anamjua.
sw.R: Rafiki zangu wapendwa, tupendane, kwa sababu upendo unatoka kwa Mungu. Kila mtu anayependa ni mtoto wa Mungu, naye anamjua Mungu.

ko.L: 사랑하는 여러분, 우리는 서로 사랑합시다. 사랑은 하나님에게서 오기 때문입니다. 사랑하는 사람은 누구나 하나님에게서 났고, 하나님을 압니다.
ko.B: 사랑하는 여러분, 우리는 계속 서로 사랑합시다. 사랑은 하나님에게서 나오기 때문입니다. 사랑하는 사람은 누구나 하나님에게서 태어났고, 하나님을 압니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 서로 사랑합시다. 사랑은 하나님에게서 오기 때문입니다. 사랑하는 사람은 누구나 하나님의 자녀이고, 하나님을 압니다.

decisions.choice: let us love: a call to keep on loving
decisions.reason: In the present tense the call and the statement have the same form. The address "Beloved" and the "ought" of 4:11 show a call. The present tense asks for love as a lasting way of life.

decisions.choice: love: the self-giving love God has shown
decisions.reason: The passage defines love by what God did: he sent his Son (4:9-10). The article marks love as a known reality, the love the passage is about.

decisions.choice: new birth comes first; love is its sign
alternatives: loving makes a person a child of God
any human affection proves birth from God
decisions.reason: The perfect "has been born" puts the birth before the loving: love shows that God has given new life, as in 2:29, 3:9 and 5:1. The love meant is love for one another as this passage describes it (4:7, 11, 20-21), not any affection at all.

decisions.choice: knows God personally
decisions.reason: As in 4:6.

decisions.choice: Dear friends
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: let us keep loving; is born of God
alternatives: let us love; has been born of God
decisions.reason: "Keep" gives the present tense of meaning decision m1. "Is born of God" states the lasting result of the perfect; Literal keeps "has been born".

decisions.choice: is God's child
decisions.reason: Readable gives the plain sense of the birth image: such a person has been made a child of God (3:1-2).

decisions.choice: amor, amar
decisions.reason: As in John's Gospel and 1 John 5, "amor" and "amar" at every level, for the self-giving love God has shown (meaning decision m1). "Caridad" now means giving to the poor.

decisions.choice: tuendelee kupendana
decisions.reason: The call is to keep on loving (m1). Balanced adds "kuendelea" (go on), as the English Balanced says "keep loving"; Literal and Readable say "tupendane" (let us love one another).

source.text: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] not loving not knew God, because the God love is.

en.L: The one who does not love has not known God, because God is love.
en.B: The one who does not love has never known God, for God is love.
en.R: Anyone who does not love has never really known God, because God is love.

fr.L: Celui qui n’aime pas n’a pas connu Dieu, car Dieu est amour.
fr.B: Celui qui n’aime pas n’a jamais connu Dieu, car Dieu est amour.
fr.R: Celui qui n’aime pas n’a jamais vraiment connu Dieu, parce que Dieu est amour.

es.L: El que no ama no ha conocido a Dios, porque Dios es amor.
es.B: El que no ama nunca ha conocido a Dios, porque Dios es amor.
es.R: Quien no ama nunca ha conocido de verdad a Dios, porque Dios es amor.

sw.L: Asiyependa hajamjua Mungu, kwa kuwa Mungu ni upendo.
sw.B: Mtu asiyependa hajawahi kumjua Mungu, kwa maana Mungu ni upendo.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote asiyependa hajawahi kumjua Mungu kwa kweli, kwa sababu Mungu ni upendo.

ko.L: 사랑하지 않는 사람은 하나님을 알지 못했습니다. 하나님은 사랑이시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 사랑하지 않는 사람은 하나님을 한 번도 알지 못했습니다. 하나님은 사랑이시기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 사랑하지 않는 사람은 하나님을 한 번도 제대로 알지 못한 사람입니다. 하나님은 사랑이시기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: has never come to know God
decisions.reason: The past tense, after the present "knows" of 4:7, looks at the whole of a life: the person who does not love never came to know God at all.

decisions.choice: God is love: love belongs to God's very nature, and everything he does is loving
alternatives: love is God (reversing subject and predicate)
God loves (only an action, not what he is)
decisions.reason: θεὸς has the article and is the subject; ἀγάπη has none and says what God is. So the sentence cannot be turned round to say that love is God, or that all love is divine. Nor does it reduce God to a feeling: the next verses define the love by what God did, sending his Son (4:9-10). It is not the whole of what can be said of God, who is also light (1:5) and spirit (John 4:24). The sentence comes again in 4:16.

decisions.choice: because: the reason not loving shows not knowing
decisions.reason: Since God is love, to know him is to be changed by his love; a life without love shows that this has not happened.

decisions.choice: has never known (B); has never really known (R)
decisions.reason: "Never" gives the sense of meaning decision m1; Literal keeps "has not known".

decisions.choice: "하나님은 사랑이시다" at every level, with the honorific copula
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as saying love belongs to God's very nature, and footnotes it; Korean keeps the noun, "사랑이시다", as "하나님은 빛이시다" in 1:5 and "하나님은 영이시다" in the Korean John 4:24.

source.text: ἐν τούτῳ ἐφανερώθη ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ ἀπέσταλκεν ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα ζήσωμεν δι’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: In this was revealed the love of God in us, that the Son of him the only one has sent God into the world so that we might live through him.

en.L: In this the love of God was revealed among us, that God has sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son, the one and only, into the world so that we might live through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: This is how God's love was made visible among us: God has sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} one and only Son into the world, so that through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} we may have life.
en.R: God made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love plain for us to see. He sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} one and only Son into the world so that we could have real life through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: En ceci l’amour de Dieu a été manifesté parmi nous : Dieu a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, l’unique, dans le monde afin que nous vivions par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Voici comment l’amour de Dieu s’est rendu visible parmi nous : Dieu a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils unique dans le monde, pour que nous ayons la vie par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Dieu nous a montré clairement {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour. Il a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils unique dans le monde pour que nous ayons la vraie vie grâce à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

es.L: En esto se manifestó el amor de Dios entre nosotros: en que Dios ha enviado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo, el unigénito, al mundo para que vivamos por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Así se hizo visible entre nosotros el amor de Dios: Dios ha enviado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo único al mundo, para que por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tengamos vida.
es.R: Dios nos mostró claramente {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor. Envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo único al mundo para que, por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, tuviéramos la vida verdadera.

sw.L: Katika hili upendo wa Mungu ulidhihirishwa kati yetu, kwamba Mungu amemtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, yule wa pekee, ulimwenguni ili tuishi kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo upendo wa Mungu ulivyoonekana wazi kati yetu: Mungu amemtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa pekee ulimwenguni, ili kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} tuwe na uzima.
sw.R: Mungu aliuonyesha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waziwazi ili tuuone. Alimtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa pekee ulimwenguni, ili tuwe na uzima wa kweli kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.

ko.L: 이것으로 하나님의 사랑이 우리 가운데 나타났습니다. 하나님께서 그분의 하나뿐인 아들을 세상에 보내셔서, 우리가 그분을 통하여 살게 하셨다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님의 사랑은 이렇게 우리 가운데 드러났습니다. 하나님께서 그분의 하나뿐인 아들을 세상에 보내셔서, 우리가 그 아들을 통해 생명을 얻게 하신 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 그분의 사랑을 우리가 볼 수 있게 분명히 보여 주셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그분의 하나뿐인 아들을 세상에 보내셔서, 우리가 그 아들을 통해 참생명을 얻게 하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: in this: points ahead to the sending of the Son
decisions.reason: The ὅτι clause says what "this" is.

decisions.choice: was revealed: shown openly, in an event that happened
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the life that appeared (1:2) and of the Son who appeared (3:5, 8). God's love was shown in history, in the coming of the Son.

decisions.choice: among us: shown to us, in what happened to us
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "in us", but here it names those to whom and for whom the love was shown; the sending of the Son into the world is the showing.

decisions.choice: one and only, unique
decisions.reason: As in John 1:14, 1:18 and 3:16: μονογενής is built from μόνος (only) and γένος (kind), not from γεννάω (beget). Hebrews 11:17 uses it of Isaac, who was not Abraham's only son. "Only begotten" came through the Latin unigenitus.

decisions.choice: has sent: a sending whose effect still stands
decisions.reason: The perfect looks at the sending and its lasting result; 4:10 tells the same event with a simple past.

decisions.choice: live: have the life of God, eternal life, through the Son
decisions.reason: In this letter life is eternal life, given in the Son (1:2; 5:11-12). Those who had been in death pass into life (3:14). Compare John 3:16 and 10:10.

decisions.choice: his Son, the one and only (L); his one and only Son (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as John 3:16 (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: may have life (B); could have real life (R)
decisions.reason: "Live" alone can sound like staying alive. "Have life" and "real life" point to the life of meaning decision m6. Literal keeps "live".

decisions.choice: God made his love plain for us to see. He sent ...
alternatives: In this the love of God was revealed among us, that ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the forward-pointing "in this" two short sentences.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, l’unique (L); {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils unique (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as the French of John 3:16 at each level (m4), as the English keeps its wording of that verse.

decisions.choice: el unigénito (L); Hijo único (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in John 3:16 in Spanish: Literal keeps "unigénito", the word Spanish readers know, and Balanced and Readable say "Hijo único", the sense of meaning decision m2.

decisions.choice: Mwana wake, yule wa pekee (L); Mwana wake wa pekee (B, R)
decisions.reason: One and only, unique (m4), as in John 3:16, where Swahili says "Mwana, yule wa pekee" at Literal and "Mwana wake wa pekee" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: tuishi (L); tuwe na uzima (B, R)
decisions.reason: To live here is to have the life of God, eternal life (m6). Literal keeps the verb "kuishi"; Balanced and Readable say "tuwe na uzima" (have life), using "uzima", the word for this life through the letter, as the English says "have life".

decisions.choice: "하나뿐인 아들" at every level
decisions.reason: The word means one and only, unique (meaning decision, footnoted). The Korean style guide gives "하나뿐인" and avoids "독생자", which follows the older reading "only begotten"; the Korean John 3:16 says "하나뿐인 아들".

source.text: ἐν τούτῳ ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, οὐχ ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠγαπήκαμεν τὸν θεόν, ἀλλ’ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἱλασμὸν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: In this is the love, not that we have loved God but that he loved us and sent the Son of him [as] a propitiation concerning the sins of us.

en.L: In this is love, not that we have loved God, but that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loved us and sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son [as] an atoning sacrifice for our sins.
en.B: This is where love is found: not in our having loved God, but in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loving us and sending {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son to be the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
en.R: This is what love really is. It is not that we loved God. It is that God loved us and sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son to be the sacrifice that takes away our sins.

fr.L: En ceci est l’amour : non que nous ayons aimé Dieu, mais qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a aimés et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils [comme] sacrifice d’expiation pour nos péchés.
fr.B: Voici où se trouve l’amour : non pas en ce que nous avons aimé Dieu, mais en ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a aimés et a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils pour être le sacrifice d’expiation pour nos péchés.
fr.R: Voici ce qu’est vraiment l’amour. Ce n’est pas que nous ayons aimé Dieu. C’est que Dieu nous a aimés et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils pour être le sacrifice qui enlève nos péchés.

es.L: En esto consiste el amor: no en que nosotros hayamos amado a Dios, sino en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos amó y envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo [como] sacrificio de expiación por nuestros pecados.
es.B: Aquí se encuentra el amor: no en que nosotros hayamos amado a Dios, sino en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos amó y envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo para ser el sacrificio que expía nuestros pecados.
es.R: Esto es lo que es de verdad el amor. No es que nosotros hayamos amado a Dios. Es que Dios nos amó y envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo para ser el sacrificio que quita nuestros pecados.

sw.L: Katika hili kuna upendo: si kwamba sisi tumempenda Mungu, bali kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alitupenda, akamtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [kuwa dhabihu ya] upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu.
sw.B: Upendo unaonekana hapa: si katika sisi kumpenda Mungu, bali katika {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kutupenda na kumtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa dhabihu inayofanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu.
sw.R: Upendo halisi ni huu. Si kwamba sisi tulimpenda Mungu. Ni kwamba Mungu alitupenda, akamtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa dhabihu inayoondoa dhambi zetu.

ko.L: 사랑은 이것에 있습니다. 우리가 하나님을 사랑한 것이 아니라, 그분이 우리를 사랑하셔서 그분의 아들을 우리 죄를 위한 속죄 제물로 보내셨다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 사랑은 바로 여기에 있습니다. 우리가 하나님을 사랑한 것이 아니라, 하나님께서 우리를 사랑하셔서 그분의 아들을 우리 죄를 속하는 제물로 보내신 것입니다.
ko.R: 참된 사랑은 이런 것입니다. 우리가 하나님을 사랑한 것이 아닙니다. 하나님께서 우리를 사랑하셔서, 그분의 아들을 보내시고 그 아들이 제물이 되어 우리 죄를 없애 주시게 하신 것입니다.

decisions.choice: in this is love: love itself is defined by what God did
alternatives: this is one example of love
decisions.reason: ἐν τούτῳ points ahead to the two ὅτι clauses. With the article, ἀγάπη is love itself, real love: it is known from God's act, not from ours.

decisions.choice: we ... he: the love began with God, not with us
decisions.reason: Both pronouns are emphatic. The contrast is taken up again in 4:19: he loved us first.

decisions.choice: atoning sacrifice: the sacrifice by which sins are dealt with and God's judgment on them is turned away
alternatives: propitiation (a sacrifice that turns away God's anger)
expiation (a sacrifice that wipes out sin)
decisions.reason: The same word, in the same sense, as in 2:2 (see the decision there). In the Greek Old Testament it belongs to the language of atonement for sin (Leviticus 25:9; Numbers 5:8; Ezekiel 44:27). Whether it stresses turning away God's anger or wiping out sin is debated; the letter speaks both of sin cleansed (1:7, 9) and of the Son as advocate with the Father (2:1). Here the sacrifice comes from God's own love: it is God's gift, not something that wins over an unwilling God. "Atoning sacrifice" keeps both sides.

decisions.choice: for our sins: to deal with them
decisions.reason: The preposition means concerning, with regard to: the sacrifice is about our sins and deals with them.

decisions.choice: This is where love is found: not in our having loved God, but in his loving us and sending
alternatives: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the two "that" clauses into matching phrases so the contrast between our love and his stays clear.

decisions.choice: atoning sacrifice
decisions.reason: "Propitiation" and "expiation" are unfamiliar to most readers and each takes one side of the debate in meaning decision m3. "Atoning sacrifice" is plain and keeps both, as in 2:2.

decisions.choice: the sacrifice that takes away our sins
decisions.reason: Readable avoids "atoning". "Takes away" echoes John 1:29, but says less than meaning decision m3 (it leaves out the turning away of judgment); a reviewer should weigh it.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God (the subject of 4:9).

decisions.choice: sacrifice d’expiation, as in 2:2
decisions.reason: French has no plain word that holds both sides of meaning decision m3, as the English "atoning sacrifice" does. "Expiation" is the general French word for atonement and is kept as in 2:2; a reviewer should weigh whether it leans toward one side of the debate, as the English decision says "expiation" does in English.

decisions.choice: sacrificio de expiación (L); sacrificio que expía (B); sacrificio que quita nuestros pecados (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:2, for the same word.

decisions.choice: [dhabihu ya] upatanisho (L); dhabihu inayofanya upatanisho (B); dhabihu inayoondoa dhambi zetu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:2: the sacrifice by which sins are dealt with (m3). The same words are used here so the reader sees the same Greek word.

decisions.choice: "속죄 제물" (L); "죄를 속하는 제물" (B); "제물이 되어 우리 죄를 없애 주시게" (R), as in 2:2
decisions.reason: The same word as 2:2, with the same Korean at each level (meaning decision, footnoted: the sacrifice by which sins are dealt with and God's judgment on them turned away).

source.text: ἀγαπητοί, εἰ οὕτως ὁ θεὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν.

records.literal_gloss: Beloved, if so God loved us, also we ought one another to love.

en.L: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
en.B: Dear friends, since this is how God loved us, we too should love one another.
en.R: Dear friends, God loved us like this. So we should love each other too.

fr.L: Bien-aimés, si Dieu nous a aimés ainsi, nous aussi nous devons nous aimer les uns les autres.
fr.B: Chers amis, puisque Dieu nous a aimés ainsi, nous aussi, nous devrions nous aimer les uns les autres.
fr.R: Chers amis, Dieu nous a aimés comme cela. Alors nous aussi, nous devrions nous aimer les uns les autres.

es.L: Amados, si Dios nos amó así, también nosotros debemos amarnos unos a otros.
es.B: Queridos amigos, ya que Dios nos amó de esta manera, también nosotros debemos amarnos unos a otros.
es.R: Queridos amigos, Dios nos amó así. Por eso nosotros también debemos amarnos unos a otros.

sw.L: Wapendwa, kama Mungu alitupenda kwa namna hii, nasi pia tuna wajibu wa kupendana.
sw.B: Rafiki zangu wapendwa, kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo Mungu alivyotupenda, sisi pia tunapaswa kupendana.
sw.R: Rafiki zangu wapendwa, Mungu alitupenda hivi. Kwa hiyo nasi pia tunapaswa kupendana.

ko.L: 사랑하는 여러분, 하나님께서 이처럼 우리를 사랑하셨다면, 우리도 서로 사랑해야 합니다.
ko.B: 사랑하는 여러분, 하나님께서 이렇게 우리를 사랑하셨으니, 우리도 서로 사랑해야 마땅합니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 하나님께서 우리를 이렇게 사랑하셨습니다. 그러니 우리도 서로 사랑해야 합니다.

decisions.choice: if, meaning since: the condition is true
decisions.reason: The "if" assumes the fact just stated (4:9-10) and argues from it.

decisions.choice: in this way: by sending his Son
decisions.reason: οὕτως means "thus, in this way", pointing back to 4:9-10, as in John 3:16. The way God loved also shows how great his love is, but the word points first to the manner.

decisions.choice: ought: we are under obligation, as people who owe a debt
decisions.reason: The verb means to owe. Having received such love, we owe love to one another (compare 2:6; 3:16).

decisions.choice: Dear friends
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: ought (L); should (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Should" is the ordinary word for an obligation; "must" would sound like a rule rather than a debt of love.

decisions.choice: tuna wajibu (L); tunapaswa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means being under obligation, as people who owe a debt (m3). Literal says "tuna wajibu" (we have a duty); Balanced and Readable say "tunapaswa" (we should), as the English does.

source.text: θεὸν οὐδεὶς πώποτε τεθέαται· ἐὰν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν μένει καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν τετελειωμένη ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: God no one ever has seen; if we love one another, God in us remains and the love of him in us having been perfected is.

en.L: No one has ever seen God; if we love one another, God remains in us, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love has been perfected in us.
en.B: No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God remains in us, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love has reached completion in us.
en.R: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God remains in us, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love has done its full work in us.

fr.L: Dieu, personne ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a jamais contemplé ; si nous nous aimons les uns les autres, Dieu demeure en nous, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour a été rendu parfait en nous.
fr.B: Personne n’a jamais vu Dieu. Si nous nous aimons les uns les autres, Dieu demeure en nous, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour est parvenu à son accomplissement en nous.
fr.R: Personne n’a jamais vu Dieu. Mais si nous nous aimons les uns les autres, Dieu demeure en nous, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour a accompli en nous toute son œuvre.

es.L: A Dios nadie {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha visto jamás; si nos amamos unos a otros, Dios permanece en nosotros, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor ha sido perfeccionado en nosotros.
es.B: Nadie ha visto nunca a Dios. Si nos amamos unos a otros, Dios permanece en nosotros, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor ha llegado a su plenitud en nosotros.
es.R: Nadie ha visto nunca a Dios. Pero si nos amamos unos a otros, Dios permanece en nosotros, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor ha hecho toda su obra en nosotros.

sw.L: Mungu hakuna mtu aliyewahi kumwona; ikiwa tunapendana sisi kwa sisi, Mungu anakaa ndani yetu, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} umekamilishwa ndani yetu.
sw.B: Hakuna aliyewahi kumwona Mungu. Tukipendana, Mungu anakaa ndani yetu, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} umefikia lengo lake ndani yetu.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu aliyewahi kumwona Mungu. Lakini tukipendana, Mungu anakaa ndani yetu, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} umefanya kazi yake kikamilifu ndani yetu.

ko.L: 아무도 하나님을 본 적이 없습니다. 우리가 서로 사랑하면, 하나님께서 우리 안에 머무시고, 그분의 사랑이 우리 안에서 완성됩니다.
ko.B: 지금까지 하나님을 본 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 그러나 우리가 서로 사랑하면, 하나님께서 우리 안에 머물러 계시고, 그분의 사랑이 우리 안에서 완성됩니다.
ko.R: 하나님을 본 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 그러나 우리가 서로 사랑하면, 하나님께서 우리 안에 머물러 계시고, 그분의 사랑이 우리 안에서 할 일을 다 이룹니다.

decisions.choice: no one has ever seen God: as John 1:18
decisions.reason: The sentence echoes John 1:18 almost word for word. There the unseen God is made known by the Son; here he is seen at work when believers love one another. θεὸν comes first for emphasis.

decisions.choice: remains: a lasting, living union
decisions.reason: As in John 6:56 and 15:4-10. This letter speaks often of God remaining in us and us in him (3:24; 4:13, 15-16).

decisions.choice: his love: God's love for us
decisions.reason: The passage is about God's love for us (4:9-11). That love reaches its goal when it goes on in our love for one another. The phrase could also mean our love for God, as perhaps in 2:5.

decisions.choice: has been brought to completion: has reached its goal
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring to its end or goal. God's love reaches what it was meant for when it is lived out among his people; it does not mean they are without sin (1:8). The same word is used in 2:5 and 4:17-18.

decisions.choice: has been perfected (L); has reached completion (B); has done its full work (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "perfected" so the word family of 4:12, 17-18 can be seen. Balanced and Readable avoid "perfect", which suggests flawlessness (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: rendu parfait (L); parvenu à son accomplissement (B); a accompli toute son œuvre (R); the same in 4:17-18
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal keeps "parfait" so that the word family of 4:12, 4:17 and 4:18 can be seen, and Balanced and Readable avoid it, since French "parfait" also suggests flawlessness (m4). Literal puts "Dieu" first, as the Greek does and as the French of John 1:18 does.

decisions.choice: ha sido perfeccionado (L); ha llegado a su plenitud (B); ha hecho toda su obra (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:5: the love has reached its goal (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps the passive verb of the English Literal; Balanced and Readable say what it means. The same in 4:17-18.

decisions.choice: umekamilishwa (L); umefikia lengo lake (B); umefanya kazi yake kikamilifu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:5: the love has reached its goal (m4). The same wording is kept in 4:17-18, so the reader can follow the one Greek verb.

source.text: Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ μένομεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: By this we know that in him we remain and he in us, because from the Spirit of him he has given to us.

en.L: By this we know that we remain in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} in us: because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit.
en.B: This is how we know that we remain in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remains in us: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Spirit.
en.R: This is how we know that we remain in God and God remains in us: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit.

fr.L: À ceci nous savons que nous demeurons en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} en nous : parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit.
fr.B: Voici comment nous savons que nous demeurons en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demeure en nous : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Esprit.
fr.R: Voici comment nous savons que nous demeurons en Dieu et que Dieu demeure en nous : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit.

es.L: En esto sabemos que permanecemos en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en nosotros: en que nos ha dado de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu.
es.B: Así sabemos que permanecemos en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} permanece en nosotros: nos ha dado de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Espíritu.
es.R: Así sabemos que permanecemos en Dios y que Dios permanece en nosotros: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos ha dado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu.

sw.L: Kwa hili tunajua kwamba tunakaa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndani yetu: kwa kuwa ametupa kutoka katika Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo tunavyojua kwamba tunakaa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anakaa ndani yetu: ametupa kutoka kwa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo tunavyojua kwamba tunakaa ndani ya Mungu na Mungu anakaa ndani yetu: ametupa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

ko.L: 이것으로 우리는 우리가 그분 안에 머물고 그분도 우리 안에 [머무신다는] 것을 압니다. 그분이 자기의 영을 우리에게 나누어 주셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 하나님 안에 머물러 있고 하나님께서 우리 안에 머물러 계시다는 것을 우리는 이렇게 압니다. 하나님께서 그분의 영을 우리에게 나누어 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 우리가 하나님 안에 머물러 있고 하나님께서 우리 안에 머물러 계시다는 것을 우리는 이렇게 압니다. 하나님께서 그분의 영을 우리에게 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: by this: the gift of the Spirit, named in the ὅτι clause
decisions.reason: The ὅτι clause tells what "this" is, as in 3:24: "by this we know that he remains in us, from the Spirit he has given us". Love for one another (4:12) is the outward sign, the Spirit the inward one.

decisions.choice: him, he: God
decisions.reason: God is the subject of 4:12 and 4:15-16.

decisions.choice: from his Spirit: God has given us a share in his Spirit
alternatives: he has given us his Spirit (all of him)
decisions.reason: The preposition takes a part from a whole. It is not that the Spirit is divided; each believer receives what God gives of his Spirit (compare 3:24).

decisions.choice: has given: given and still possessed
decisions.reason: The perfect says the gift was given and remains with us.

decisions.choice: from his own Spirit (B); his Spirit (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the sense of sharing (meaning decision m3); Readable says simply that God has given his Spirit, which the share does not contradict.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: ametupa kutoka katika Roho wake (L); kutoka kwa Roho wake mwenyewe (B)
decisions.reason: God has given us a share in his Spirit (m3). Literal and Balanced keep the Greek "from", which points to a share; Readable says simply "he has given us his Spirit", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "자기의 영을 ... 나누어 주셨기" (L); "그분의 영을 ... 나누어 주셨습니다" (B)
decisions.reason: "From his Spirit" means God has given us a share in his Spirit (meaning decision); Korean "나누어 주다" (give a share) keeps the partitive sense. "그분의 영" names the Holy Spirit as God's own, with the honorific "그분".

source.text: καὶ ἡμεῖς τεθεάμεθα καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ ἀπέσταλκεν τὸν υἱὸν σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου.

records.literal_gloss: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son [as] Savior of the world.

en.L: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son [as] Savior of the world.
en.B: We have seen it with our own eyes, and we testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
en.R: We have seen this with our own eyes, and we tell others about it: the Father sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.

fr.L: Et nous, nous avons contemplé et nous rendons témoignage que le Père a envoyé le Fils [comme] Sauveur du monde.
fr.B: Nous l’avons vu de nos propres yeux, et nous rendons témoignage que le Père a envoyé le Fils comme Sauveur du monde.
fr.R: Nous avons vu cela de nos propres yeux, et nous le disons aux autres : le Père a envoyé le Fils pour être le Sauveur du monde.

es.L: Y nosotros hemos visto y damos testimonio de que el Padre ha enviado al Hijo [como] Salvador del mundo.
es.B: Nosotros lo hemos visto con nuestros propios ojos, y damos testimonio de que el Padre ha enviado al Hijo como Salvador del mundo.
es.R: Nosotros hemos visto esto con nuestros propios ojos, y se lo contamos a otros: el Padre envió al Hijo para ser el Salvador del mundo.

sw.L: Nasi tumetazama na tunashuhudia kwamba Baba amemtuma Mwana [kuwa] Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.
sw.B: Tumeona kwa macho yetu wenyewe, nasi tunashuhudia kwamba Baba amemtuma Mwana awe Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.
sw.R: Tumeliona jambo hili kwa macho yetu wenyewe, nasi tunawaambia wengine habari zake: Baba alimtuma Mwana awe Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.

ko.L: 그리고 우리는 아버지께서 아들을 세상의 구주로 보내셨다는 것을 보았고 증언합니다.
ko.B: 우리는 아버지께서 아들을 세상의 구주로 보내셨다는 것을 우리 눈으로 보았고, 그것을 증언합니다.
ko.R: 우리는 우리 눈으로 이것을 보았고, 다른 사람들에게 그것을 증언합니다. 아버지께서는 아들을 보내셔서 세상의 구주가 되게 하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: we have seen: the eyewitnesses saw the Son
alternatives: all believers have seen, with the eyes of faith
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 1:1 ("what we have looked at") and John 1:14 ("we have seen his glory"). No one has seen God (4:12), but the witnesses saw the Son he sent.

decisions.choice: testify: give witness, as those who saw
decisions.reason: As in 1:2 and John 1:7. The present tense: they go on bearing witness.

decisions.choice: Savior of the world: the one who saves people from every nation
decisions.reason: Key term. The Samaritans give Jesus this title in John 4:42. The world here is humanity, which the Son came to save (John 3:17); compare 2:2, "the whole world".

decisions.choice: it / this with our own eyes
decisions.reason: English needs an object for "seen"; "with our own eyes" gives the eyewitness sense of meaning decision m1.

decisions.choice: tell others about it
decisions.reason: "Testify" sounds like a courtroom to a young reader; Readable says what the witnesses do.

decisions.choice: "증언하다" for testify; "구주" for Savior
decisions.reason: "증언하다" is the style guide's word for testifying in John; "구주" is the established word for Savior, as in 2 Peter.

source.text: ὃς ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God in him remains and he in God.

en.L: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in {{gender:them|him}} and {{gender:they|he}} in God.
en.B: When anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in {{gender:them|him}}, and {{gender:they remain|he remains}} in God.
en.R: If people openly say that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in them, and they remain in God.

fr.L: Celui qui confesse que Jésus est le Fils de Dieu, Dieu demeure en lui et lui en Dieu.
fr.B: Quand quelqu’un confesse que Jésus est le Fils de Dieu, Dieu demeure en lui, et lui demeure en Dieu.
fr.R: Si des gens disent ouvertement que Jésus est le Fils de Dieu, Dieu demeure en eux, et ils demeurent en Dieu.

es.L: Cualquiera que confiesa que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios, Dios permanece en {{gender:esa persona|él}}, y {{gender:esa persona|él}} en Dios.
es.B: Cuando alguien confiesa que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios, Dios permanece en {{gender:esa persona|él}}, y {{gender:esa persona|él}} permanece en Dios.
es.R: Si las personas dicen abiertamente que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios, Dios permanece en ellas, y ellas permanecen en Dios.

sw.L: Mtu yeyote akikiri kwamba Yesu ndiye Mwana wa Mungu, Mungu anakaa ndani ya mtu huyo, na mtu huyo ndani ya Mungu.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote anapokiri kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu, Mungu anakaa ndani yake, naye anakaa ndani ya Mungu.
sw.R: Watu wakisema waziwazi kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu, Mungu anakaa ndani yao, nao wanakaa ndani ya Mungu.

ko.L: 누구든지 예수께서 하나님의 아들이심을 시인하면, 하나님께서 그 사람 안에 머무시고, 그 사람도 하나님 안에 [머뭅니다].
ko.B: 누구든지 예수께서 하나님의 아들이심을 시인하면, 하나님께서 그 사람 안에 머물러 계시고, 그 사람도 하나님 안에 머물러 있습니다.
ko.R: 누구든지 예수님께서 하나님의 아들이시라고 공개적으로 말하면, 하나님께서 그 사람 안에 머물러 계시고, 그 사람도 하나님 안에 머물러 있습니다.

decisions.choice: whoever confesses: anyone at all who makes this confession
decisions.reason: The general relative with the subjunctive covers every case. The confession is a real one, matched by life (compare 4:20).

decisions.choice: Jesus is the Son of God: the confession that marks those who belong to God
decisions.reason: The same confession is the test in 2:22-23 and 5:5, 10; it answers those who deny that Jesus is the Christ, the Son.

decisions.choice: God remains in them and they in God: a mutual indwelling
decisions.reason: As in 4:13 and 4:16, and in John 6:56 and 15:4.

decisions.choice: {{gender:them|him}}; {{gender:they|he}}
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone who confesses. Readable uses the plural and needs no setting.

decisions.choice: openly say
decisions.reason: As in 4:2.

decisions.choice: naye (the believer), no span
decisions.reason: Here "naye" (and he) means the person who confesses, not God (m3), so it takes no deity_pronoun span; Swahili verbs and pronouns do not mark sex, so the English gender spans have no counterpart.

source.text: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐγνώκαμεν καὶ πεπιστεύκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχει ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: And we have known and have believed the love that has God in us.

en.L: And we have known and have believed the love that God has in us.
en.B: We ourselves have come to know the love God has for us, and we believe it.
en.R: We know the love God has for us, and we believe in it.

fr.L: Et nous, nous avons connu et nous avons cru l’amour que Dieu a pour nous.
fr.B: Nous-mêmes, nous avons appris à connaître l’amour que Dieu a pour nous, et nous y croyons.
fr.R: Nous connaissons l’amour que Dieu a pour nous, et nous y croyons.

es.L: Y nosotros hemos conocido y hemos creído el amor que Dios tiene en nosotros.
es.B: Nosotros mismos hemos llegado a conocer el amor que Dios nos tiene, y lo creemos.
es.R: Nosotros conocemos el amor que Dios nos tiene, y creemos en él.

sw.L: Nasi tumeujua na tumeuamini upendo ambao Mungu anao ndani yetu.
sw.B: Sisi wenyewe tumekuja kuujua upendo ambao Mungu anao kwetu, nasi tunauamini.
sw.R: Tunaujua upendo ambao Mungu anao kwetu, nasi tunauamini.

ko.L: 그리고 우리는 하나님께서 우리 안에 가지고 계신 사랑을 알았고 믿었습니다.
ko.B: 우리는 하나님께서 우리에게 품고 계신 사랑을 알게 되었고, 그 사랑을 믿습니다.
ko.R: 우리는 하나님께서 우리를 사랑하신다는 것을 알고, 그 사랑을 믿습니다.

decisions.choice: we ourselves: the witnesses of 4:14, with all who confess (4:15)
decisions.reason: The emphatic pronoun links back to the witnesses; the "we" here seems wide enough to include every believer.

decisions.choice: have come to know and have come to believe: and still do
decisions.reason: Both verbs are perfect: a knowledge and a belief reached and still held. Peter joins the same two verbs in John 6:69.

decisions.choice: for us: the love God has toward us, shown in our case
decisions.reason: As in 4:9, the phrase names those to whom God's love is directed and in whom it is at work.

decisions.choice: believe: accept as true and rely on
decisions.reason: Key term. Here the object is God's love: to believe it is to accept it and rest on it.

decisions.choice: come to know the love ..., and we believe it
alternatives: have come to know and believe the love
decisions.reason: English joins the two verbs to one object awkwardly; Balanced and Readable name the love once and come back to it with "it".

decisions.choice: l’amour que Dieu a pour nous (L)
alternatives: l’amour que Dieu a en nous
decisions.reason: The English Literal keeps "in us". In French "l’amour que Dieu a en nous" would suggest a love God keeps inside us; the phrase means the love God has toward us, shown in our case (m3), which "pour nous" says.

decisions.choice: que Dios tiene en nosotros (L); que Dios nos tiene (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "in us", which may mean among us or toward us; Balanced and Readable follow the English and say "nos tiene", the love God has for us.

source.text: Ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν, καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει.

records.literal_gloss: The God love is, and the [one] remaining in the love in the God remains and the God in him remains.

en.L: God is love, and the one who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: God is love. Whoever remains in love remains in God, and God remains in {{gender:them|him}}.
en.R: God is love. Anyone who keeps on loving remains in God, and God remains in {{gender:them|him}}.

fr.L: Dieu est amour, et celui qui demeure dans l’amour demeure en Dieu, et Dieu demeure en lui.
fr.B: Dieu est amour. Celui qui demeure dans l’amour demeure en Dieu, et Dieu demeure en lui.
fr.R: Dieu est amour. Celui qui continue à aimer demeure en Dieu, et Dieu demeure en lui.

es.L: Dios es amor, y el que permanece en el amor permanece en Dios, y Dios permanece en {{gender:esa persona|él}}.
es.B: Dios es amor. Quien permanece en el amor permanece en Dios, y Dios permanece en {{gender:esa persona|él}}.
es.R: Dios es amor. Quien sigue amando permanece en Dios, y Dios permanece en {{gender:esa persona|él}}.

sw.L: Mungu ni upendo, na anayekaa katika upendo anakaa katika Mungu, na Mungu anakaa ndani yake.
sw.B: Mungu ni upendo. Yeyote anayekaa katika upendo anakaa ndani ya Mungu, na Mungu anakaa ndani yake.
sw.R: Mungu ni upendo. Mtu anayeendelea kupenda anakaa ndani ya Mungu, na Mungu anakaa ndani yake.

ko.L: 하나님은 사랑이십니다. 사랑 안에 머무는 사람은 하나님 안에 머물고, 하나님께서도 그 사람 안에 머무십니다.
ko.B: 하나님은 사랑이십니다. 사랑 안에 머물러 있는 사람은 하나님 안에 머물러 있고, 하나님께서도 그 사람 안에 머물러 계십니다.
ko.R: 하나님은 사랑이십니다. 계속 사랑하는 사람은 하나님 안에 머물러 있고, 하나님께서도 그 사람 안에 머물러 계십니다.

decisions.choice: God is love: as in 4:8
decisions.reason: See the decision at 4:8 on what the sentence says and does not say. Here it grounds the promise that follows: to remain in love is to remain in God.

decisions.choice: remains in love: goes on living in the love God has shown, by loving others
alternatives: remains in God's love for us, without reference to our love
decisions.reason: The love is the love God has for us (4:16a), lived out in love for one another (4:12). The two belong together.

decisions.choice: remains in God and God in them: the mutual indwelling of 4:13, 15
decisions.reason: The verb comes three times in one sentence.

decisions.choice: keeps on loving
decisions.reason: "Remain in love" can sound like a feeling one stays in; Readable gives the sense of meaning decision m2.

decisions.choice: {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone who remains in love.

decisions.choice: "머무르다" for the believer, "머물러 계시다" / "머무시다" with the honorific for God
alternatives: the same verb form for both
decisions.reason: The mutual remaining of God and the believer (meaning decision) uses one Greek verb; Korean keeps the one verb "머무르다" and gives God the honorific form, so the key term stays visible while the speech level is right.

source.text: ἐν τούτῳ τετελείωται ἡ ἀγάπη μεθ’ ἡμῶν, ἵνα παρρησίαν ἔχωμεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς κρίσεως, ὅτι καθὼς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ.

records.literal_gloss: In this has been perfected the love with us, so that confidence we may have in the day of the judgment, because just as that one is also we are in the world this.

en.L: In this love has been perfected with us, so that we may have boldness on the day of judgment, because just as that one is, so also are we in this world.
en.B: In this way love has been brought to completion among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment, for just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is, so are we in this world.
en.R: This is how love has done its full work among us, so that we can be confident on the day of judgment. For even now, here in this world, we are as Jesus is.

fr.L: En ceci l’amour a été rendu parfait avec nous, afin que nous ayons de l’assurance au jour du jugement, parce que tel est celui-là, tels aussi nous sommes dans ce monde.
fr.B: C’est ainsi que l’amour est parvenu à son accomplissement parmi nous, afin que nous ayons de l’assurance au jour du jugement ; car tel {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est, tels nous sommes, nous aussi, dans ce monde.
fr.R: Voici comment l’amour a accompli toute son œuvre parmi nous : nous pourrons avoir de l’assurance au jour du jugement. Car dès maintenant, ici, dans ce monde, nous sommes comme Jésus est.

es.L: En esto ha sido perfeccionado el amor con nosotros, para que tengamos confianza en el día del juicio, porque como aquel es, así somos también nosotros en este mundo.
es.B: Así el amor ha llegado a su plenitud entre nosotros, para que tengamos confianza en el día del juicio, porque tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es, así somos nosotros en este mundo.
es.R: Así es como el amor ha hecho toda su obra entre nosotros, para que podamos estar confiados en el día del juicio. Porque ya ahora, aquí en este mundo, somos como es Jesús.

sw.L: Kwa hili upendo umekamilishwa pamoja nasi, ili tupate uhuru siku ya hukumu, kwa kuwa jinsi yule alivyo, sisi nasi tuko hivyo katika ulimwengu huu.
sw.B: Kwa njia hii upendo umefikia lengo lake kati yetu, ili tuwe na ujasiri siku ya hukumu, kwa maana jinsi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyo, ndivyo tulivyo nasi katika ulimwengu huu.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo upendo ulivyofanya kazi yake kikamilifu kati yetu, ili tuweze kusimama bila hofu siku ya hukumu. Kwa maana hata sasa, hapa katika ulimwengu huu, sisi tuko kama Yesu alivyo.

ko.L: 이것으로 사랑이 우리와 함께 완성되었습니다. 이는 우리가 심판의 날에 담대함을 가지게 하려는 것입니다. 그분이 계신 것처럼 우리도 이 세상에 있기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 사랑이 우리 가운데서 완성되었습니다. 그것은 우리가 심판의 날에 담대할 수 있게 하려는 것입니다. 그분이 계신 그대로 우리도 이 세상에 있기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 이렇게 하여 사랑이 우리 가운데서 할 일을 다 이루었습니다. 그래서 우리는 심판의 날에 두려움 없이 설 수 있습니다. 지금 이 세상에서도 우리는 예수님과 같기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: in this: in our remaining in love and God in us (4:16), with the goal that we have confidence
alternatives: points ahead: love is brought to completion in this, that we have confidence
points ahead to the last clause: in being as he is
decisions.reason: ἐν τούτῳ usually points ahead in this letter, and the ἵνα clause could say what "this" is. But a purpose clause rarely explains "this", so many read it as pointing back to 4:16. The sense is close either way: love brought to its goal gives confidence.

decisions.choice: with us: among us, in our life together
decisions.reason: The preposition means "with": love at work in the community.

decisions.choice: confidence: freedom to stand before someone without fear or shame
